ex3_captions.caption: a young king
ex3_captions.scene: A laughing young man dressed as a king, in a crown, red velvet robe and white fur cape, rides a quad bike through a muddy puddle in a park, with a big stone house behind.
models: a young king on a quad bike

ex3_captions.caption: a king and his queen
ex3_captions.scene: An older king with a white beard and a crown drives a quad bike through mud. A gray-haired woman in a green coat and a tiara sits behind him, holding on and laughing.
models: a king and queen on a quad bike

ex3_captions.caption: to meet the king
ex3_captions.scene: A king in a crown and red robe sits on a parked quad bike by a muddy puddle and waves. Three people in rubber boots, one a young woman in a red coat, bow to him.
